newsitem.title: UK: UK's Offer rules out generator/supplier mergers.
newsitem.headline: UK's Offer rules out generator/supplier mergers.

text.p: UK electricity industry regulator Stephen Littlechild said on Wednesday that he believed partnerships between electricity generators and suppliers would be bad for competition and he would not support any merger.

"My view has not changed since National Power and PowerGen tried to take over RECs (Regional Electricity Companies). I feared it would hamper competition in both generation and supply, and I still take that view. I wouldn't want to support a merger of the same kind," he said.

He added there could be a case for allowing mergers between certain parts of RECs, saying there could be advantages in uniting some back office functions such as Information Technology systems. But he was cautious about the possibility of mergers in the supply business itself of RECs.
